title: Renewal of the ball bearing 6306 agreement

messages.subject: Quote from Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH: Renewal of the ball bearing 6306 agreement
messages.body:
Dear customer,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. We are pleased to present our current offer for your requirements, maintaining our commitment to supporting your business with top-quality service and our extensive product range.

For this offer, we quote a price of €4.96 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel 30 days net and a contract term of 12 months. Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

To provide some background on our pricing calculations, LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 10 % of our cost. Furthermore, PPI-C2815 rose 0.8 % in twelve months and is 65 % of our cost.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Florian Gruber
Inside Sales, Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH

messages.subject: Renewal ctr:4600070620 – part:360020 ball bearing 6306-2Z C3: multi-year volume agreement
messages.body:
Dear Mr Gruber,

Thank you for your offer for the renewal of ctr:4600070620.

The forecast for part:360020 increased by 4.2% (fc:360020@2026-09); please reflect this additional business in your price.

You mentioned that only multi-year volume agreements change prices. We therefore propose a multi-year agreement. It covers 20000 pieces per year over 24 or 36 months. It gives you a secured, plannable volume and reduces your quoting workload. Payment terms continue as in our current agreement. Our proposed packages are attached.

Could you also tell us whether a cheaper variant, for example in packaging or call-off pattern, would lower your price?

Best regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

messages.subject: Re: Renewal ctr:4600070620 – part:360020 ball bearing 6306-2Z C3: multi-year volume agreement
messages.body:
Dear customer,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We checked the volume change data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation. That does not change our position. 

Thank you for your proposal for a multi-year agreement; we can offer €4.88 for a 24-month contract with 30-day payment terms. This price reflects the maximum reduction we can offer for the extended commitment. Beside this alternative, our current Angebot is a price of €4.91 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, a contract term of 24 months. Our offer stays valid for 30 days.

Our price follows our main cost drivers: PPI-C2815, LCI-C. Our technical team will gladly review if alternative packaging or call-off patterns could provide cost benefits. From our calculation: a cheaper material grade would save about EUR 0.26 per unit; a wider tolerance would save about EUR 0.08 per unit; doubling the lot size would save about EUR 0.05 per unit. Each needs your engineering approval and a new drawing revision.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Florian Gruber
Inside Sales, Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH

messages.subject: Renewal ctr:4600070620 – revised multi-year package for part:360020
messages.body:
Dear Mr Gruber,

Thank you for your revised offer and for confirming that a multi-year agreement can change the price.

We have moved towards you in the attached package. It covers 20000 pieces per year over a 24-month contract, with payment terms as in our current agreement. That gives you a secured, plannable volume without renewed quoting effort during the term, and it keeps order handling simple for both sides.

Your message mentioned a cheaper material or packaging variant. Could you describe it and tell us how it would affect your price? We would gladly assess it with our technical team.

Best regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

messages.subject: Re: Renewal ctr:4600070620 – revised multi-year package for part:360020
messages.body:
Dear customer,

Thank you for your revised offer; however, we are unable to reduce our price further for the 24-month term with 60-day payment terms. Please consider this as our final offer (letztes Angebot), so we kindly ask you to decide. Our proposal stands at a price of €4.91 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, a contract term of 24 months. This offer remains valid for 7 days.

Our price follows our main cost drivers: PPI-C2815, LCI-C. Regarding the simplified order handling you mentioned, please provide data quantifying these savings so we can review them. 

From our calculation: a cheaper material grade would save about EUR 0.26 per unit; a wider tolerance would save about EUR 0.08 per unit; doubling the lot size would save about EUR 0.05 per unit. Each needs your engineering approval and a new drawing revision. Our technical team will gladly provide the detailed specifications for the alternative material grade and wider tolerance options for your engineering assessment.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Florian Gruber
Inside Sales, Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH
